controls.case: fresh-process resume keeps original deadline and separate output evidence
expired checkpoint refuses command before input
running deadline stops own process and preserves partial stdout stderr
child failure remains explicit and cannot silently restart the window
kernel lock refuses concurrent duplicate command
unresolved running receipt fails closed without assuming the job stopped
deadline kills remaining process group after leader exits
existing evidence is never overwritten or treated as a new attempt
command launch failure is persisted and returned
historical frozen route cannot be mistaken for a fresh work window

scope: Command wall-clock enforcement only; not agent reasoning or AI policy quality
